title: Dense Li deposition enabled by weakly coordinated Li and fast Li transport in a single-ion conducting gel-polymer electrolyte
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,8352-8365
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02373D, Paper
Yutong Zhai, Yimu Zhang, Ning Wang, Minghui Li, Mingjia Shen, Pingbo Xu, Maoyu Sun, Feilong Dong, Tianzong Ma, Jun Ming, Lina Cong, Haiming Xie, Yulong Liu
This study proposes an innovative ordered regulation strategy for solvation structures in gel polymer electrolytes for quasi-solid high-voltage lithium metal batteries.
